dialogues.jp: たまには目先を変えたモノが食いたいな……。
dialogues.en: I should eat something different once in a while...
dialogues.text: I should eat something different once in a while...

dialogues.jp:
そう思って校門へ向かうと、そこには見知った
顔がふたつ。
dialogues.en:
I thought that as I exited the school premises, and found
two familiar faces.
dialogues.text:
I thought that as I exited the school premises, and found
two familiar faces.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「あれ、朝倉？」
dialogues.en: "Huh, Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "Huh, Asakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「よっ」
dialogues.en: "Yo."
dialogues.text: "Yo."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「お前ら、何してるんだ？　飯食わないのか」
dialogues.en: "You guys aren't having lunch? What're you doing?"
dialogues.text: "You guys aren't having lunch? What're you doing?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「いや、たまには目先を変えたモノを食いたい
　と思ってな」
dialogues.en:
"Nope, we just thought we should eat something different
once in a while."
dialogues.text:
"Nope, we just thought we should eat something different
once in a while."

dialogues.jp: 俺の心持ちそのままの台詞を吐く杉並。
dialogues.en: Suginami expressed my own thoughts clear as day.
dialogues.text: Suginami expressed my own thoughts clear as day.

dialogues.jp: なんなのだ、このシンクロ率は。気色の悪い。
dialogues.en: Are we having a good synchro rate? I'm going to be sick.
dialogues.text: Are we having a good synchro rate? I'm going to be sick.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「朝倉こそ、どうしたんだよ」
dialogues.en: "What about you, Asakura?"
dialogues.text: "What about you, Asakura?"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「いや……その、俺も同じなんだが」
dialogues.en: "Er... I was thinking the same thing."
dialogues.text: "Er... I was thinking the same thing."

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「おお、そうかそうか！　気が合うな。やはり、
　我らは熱き友情で結ばれているのだ」
dialogues.en:
"Ohhh, indeed, indeed! Our minds are one. Indeed, our
burning friendship binds us together!"
dialogues.text:
"Ohhh, indeed, indeed! Our minds are one. Indeed, our
burning friendship binds us together!"

dialogues.jp: がっしりと手を握ってくる杉並。
dialogues.en: I waved my hand dismissively at Suginami.
dialogues.text: I waved my hand dismissively at Suginami.

dialogues.jp:
認めたくはないが、気があってしまうのは事実
であるようだ。
dialogues.en:
Whether or not I accepted it though, I really was thinking
that.
dialogues.text:
Whether or not I accepted it though, I really was thinking
that.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「よし、それじゃ三人で豪華なランチタイムと
　いこうではないか！」
dialogues.en:
"Then, let the three of us experience the most wonderous of
lunchtimes!"
dialogues.text:
"Then, let the three of us experience the most wonderous of
lunchtimes!"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「って、店にでも食いに行くつもりか？」
dialogues.en: "Uh, you mean eating at a restaurant?"
dialogues.text: "Uh, you mean eating at a restaurant?"

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp:
「うむ。そうだ工藤、確かよく行く和食系の店
　があると言っていたな。そこへ案内しろよ」
dialogues.en:
"Mm. You said you knew a good Japanese-style restaurant,
Kudou. Elaborate!"
dialogues.text:
"Mm. You said you knew a good Japanese-style restaurant,
Kudou. Elaborate!"

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp:
「外へ食いになんか行ってたら、午後の授業に
　間に合わないだろ」
dialogues.en:
"If we go outside to eat now, we definitely won't make it
back for afternoon classes."
dialogues.text:
"If we go outside to eat now, we definitely won't make it
back for afternoon classes."

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「工藤の言うとおりだぞ」
dialogues.en: "I agree with Kudou."
dialogues.text: "I agree with Kudou."

dialogues.jp:
真面目な顔で杉並を諭す工藤に、俺も横から頷
いて見せた。
dialogues.en:
As Kudou's serious face lightly admonished Suginami, I
nodded sagely at his side.
dialogues.text:
As Kudou's serious face lightly admonished Suginami, I
nodded sagely at his side.

dialogues.speaker: Suginami
dialogues.jp: 「そうか……残念だな」
dialogues.en: "That's true... regrettable."
dialogues.text: "That's true... regrettable."

dialogues.jp: たく、音夢が知ったら何と言うか。
dialogues.en: And what would Nemu say if she found out.
dialogues.text: And what would Nemu say if she found out.

dialogues.jp: 「コンビニでも行ってみようぜ」
dialogues.en: "Let's just go to a convenience store."
dialogues.text: "Let's just go to a convenience store."

dialogues.jp: そんなふうに代替案を出してみる。
dialogues.en: I proposed an alternative plan.
dialogues.text: I proposed an alternative plan.

dialogues.speaker: Kudou
dialogues.jp: 「……うん、そのへんが妥当な線だな」
dialogues.en: "...Yeah, that kind of change is acceptable."
dialogues.text: "...Yeah, that kind of change is acceptable."

dialogues.jp:
そうして俺達は三人連れ立って近場のコンビニ
へ物資調達へ出かけたのだった。
dialogues.en:
Then, the three of us walked to a nearby convenience and
provisions store.
dialogues.text:
Then, the three of us walked to a nearby convenience and
provisions store.

dialogues.jp:
売ってるものは別に目新しいもんじゃなかった
けど、友達とつるんでする買い物はなんだか楽
しかった。
dialogues.en:
Just buying things isn't amazingly interesting, but doing it
with friends always makes it more enjoyable.
dialogues.text:
Just buying things isn't amazingly interesting, but doing it
with friends always makes it more enjoyable.

dialogues.jp: ◆昼飯談義１◆
dialogues.en: ◆Lunch Lecture 1◆
dialogues.text: ◆Lunch Lecture 1◆

dialogues.jp:
いつもの昼飯と目先を変えてみようと思った俺
は、杉並、工藤と共に、近場のコンビニへ食料
を調達しに行ったのだった。
dialogues.en:
Wanting a change from the usual lunchtime menu, I went with
Suginami and Kudou to a nearby convenience store to buy some
take-out.
dialogues.text:
Wanting a change from the usual lunchtime menu, I went with
Suginami and Kudou to a nearby convenience store to buy some
take-out.
